title: Verify: Null store focus clears scene focus unit tests
summary: Phaser-mocked tests for clearing focus on null
description: TDD unit tests proving that setting focusedObjectId to null removes highlight and label (blur) from focused objects.
acceptance_criteria: Null focusedObjectId blurs a focused object
Null with nothing focused makes no blur call

steps.action: Create the file with the same vi.mock block as bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts and one fake object (spec.id 'bookshelf', focus/blur vi.fn(), mutable isFocused). Call boot.create() and reset the store with setFocusedObject(null) in beforeEach.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocusClear.test.ts

steps.symbol: it('clears focus when focusedObjectId becomes null')
steps.action: Call setFocusedObject('bookshelf'), set fake.isFocused = true, call setFocusedObject(null); assert fake.blur called once.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocusClear.test.ts -t 'clears focus'

steps.symbol: it('does not blur when nothing is focused')
steps.action: With fake.isFocused = false call setFocusedObject('x') then setFocusedObject(null); assert fake.blur not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocusClear.test.ts
steps.expected: All tests in the file pass
